channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why Israel could still derail the Iran-US deal
item.description: Trump called it a historic deal. But with nuclear talks and Israel all unresolved, what did either side actually win?

item.description: An internationally acclaimed photojournalist in Iran turns his lens on his own city, as Tehran comes under bombardment.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz reopens: But can ships’ safety be assured?
item.description: Shipping operators and insurers prefer to wait and watch from a distance for now.

item.title: Trump accuses Obama of ‘bribing’ Iran in 2015 nuclear deal at G7 summit
item.description: US President Donald Trump has accused his predecessor Barack Obama of ‘bribing’ Iran to agree to the 2015 nuclear deal.

item.title: Israeli air strikes on Lebanon continue despite US-Iran deal
item.description: There has been a reduction in violence since the US-Iran agreement was announced, but attacks have not stopped.

item.description: China pledges new humanitarian aid packages for Lebanon and Iran.

item.title: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon despite Trump criticism
item.description: Speaking on Tuesday, Trump said Israel's PM Benjamin Netanyahu needed "to be more responsible with respect to Lebanon".

item.title: Status quo at Jerusalem's holiest site under threat as Israeli nationalists flout rules
item.description: Israeli nationalists are increasingly flouting a convention on how faiths share the al-Aqsa mosque compound.

item.title: Iran sends tankers loaded with oil past US military blockade
item.description: Three Iranian tankers loaded with crude oil have passed the US blockade line in the Gulf of Oman, ship-tracking data shows.

item.title: The bikers battling extreme heat and armed conflict to smuggle Iranian fuel to Pakistan
item.description: It's so hot the fuel can catch fire - the bikers tell the BBC they must live with the risk of injury and death.
